sms_usage_reports_reported_at_check.name: sms_usage_reports_reported_at_check
sms_usage_reports_reported_at_check.value: ("sms_usage_reports"."report_status" = 'submitted' AND "sms_usage_reports"."reported_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("sms_usage_reports"."report_status" IN ('pending', 'uncertain') AND "sms_usage_reports"."reported_at" IS NULL)

sms_usage_reports_dispatch_facts_check.name: sms_usage_reports_dispatch_facts_check
sms_usage_reports_dispatch_facts_check.value: "sms_usage_reports"."report_status" = 'submitted' OR ("sms_usage_reports"."customer_id" IS NOT NULL AND "sms_usage_reports"."subscription_id" IS NOT NULL AND "sms_usage_reports"."meter_event_identifier" IS NOT NULL AND "sms_usage_reports"."meter_event_timestamp" IS NOT NULL AND "sms_usage_reports"."first_attempt_at" IS NOT NULL AND "sms_usage_reports"."quantity" >= 0 AND "sms_usage_reports"."meter_event_timestamp" >= 0)

hosted_text_ready_check.name: hosted_text_ready_check
hosted_text_ready_check.value: "hosted_text_billing_state"."lifecycle_state" <> 'ready' OR ("hosted_text_billing_state"."billable_from" IS NOT NULL AND "hosted_text_billing_state"."meter_item_id" IS NOT NULL)
